review_response.finding: The scenario is a single step (minor).
review_response.action: kept because: ENISA ends at 'unauthorized access to and hence compromise of satellite lifecycle assets'; IA-0007 is the only kept technique and the result is shown as access only.

review_response.finding: 'Software vulnerabilities' and 'misconfigurations' are sent to TR48's EX-0009.x, which only runs from supply_chain (minor).
review_response.action: kept because: EX-0009.x exploits on-board code, while TR47's exploitation is of the ground network; SPARTA has no ground-side exploit technique, so the exploit itself is carried by IA-0007.

review_response.finding: REC-0008.03 P-PREP for IA-0007 although it is a flight/ground vulnerability catalogue (minor).
review_response.action: kept because: ENISA says software vulnerabilities are exploited, and SPARTA's text says the catalogue is used to pivot from ground assets to flight.
